svg.title: Animated walkthrough of MILES at test time
svg.desc: Questions arrive without labels and a frozen LLM answers each one K = 10 times. When the answers agree (question q_t), the question is confident and goes to WRITE: the majority answer is the pseudo-label, MCTS rollouts that applied units u2 and u4 are scored against it, a step with no matching unit becomes a seed, seeds are summarized into a new memory unit u5, and the per-unit selection heads are trained with BCE. When the answers disagree (question q_t+1), the question is uncertain and goes to READ: the LLM proposes a step-goal, Layer 1 retrieves the units with the most similar sub-goals (u4, u2, u5), the learned Layer-2 heads rerank them so that u5 comes first, u5 guides the next reasoning step, and the response pool is majority-voted. Memory keeps growing along the stream while the LLM stays frozen. Answer counts and scores are illustrative.
